title: 河谷里未说完的话

connections.location: Part I, W034/U142-U149; Part II corresponding examples; Part III S007/S031
connections.meaning: reed: plant/stem and musical pipe/reed; visual reed pipe represents breath becoming voice.
germinate and oak; seed at folded leaf is an original symbolic combination, not a claimed scene from the story.
specimen, old handwriting, records and letters; collected traces keep a valley conversation alive.

Mara labelled a preserved plant as a scientific specimen and placed a specimen of the first miller's handwriting beside it.
`玛拉把一株保存下来的植物标为科学标本，又在旁边放上一份首任磨坊主的笔迹样本。`
titleTranslation: Words Unfinished in the Valley is the keepsake translation; Of Leaf and Letter is the separate artistic title.
differenceFromChapterOne: Horizontal miniature and centered two-stanza text replace the first specimen’s narrow left margin and right prose. Same series paper and seal; paper mother texture mirrored, not newly generated.
